_meta.notes: Form masthead reads '2020 Financial Disclosure Report For a Candidate' filed for the 2024 cycle (report date 06/18/24; 'Seven days before a primary election' checked; amendment 'No' checked). Cover street address and phone/email bar-redacted; Schedule A 'Complete Mailing Address' column bar-redacted on every page, so donor city/state are blank 'redacted at source' throughout. Many name/occupation strings are clipped at cell boundaries by the filer's OWN generator (a source truncation, not redaction and not a read failure); transcribed glyphs are verbatim and complete as printed. p12 has 14 filled rows (one ruled row left blank); p14 has 7 filled rows. Schedule A page subtotals and the printed grand total exclude the single in-kind row (p6 r13, 1250.00, 'In-Kind' printed under the amount) - that row is the whole of the 1250.00 gap between the schedule grand total 35247.97 and Summary line 1 36497.97. Schedule B includes the matching Ryan Sullivan 'Website Creation' 1250.00 (03/29/2024) with no in-kind mark. Joel Frost's 1001.97 contribution (01/05/2024) mirrors Schedule B 'Salt Lake County - Election Filing' 1001.97 (candidate-funded filing fee). Schedule B p14 row 2 is dated 05/29/2027 - a well-formed filer typo, kept verbatim. Summary Column B prints $0.00 on both lines. Chunk-file priors confirmed at the page: c_rows=149, e_rows=21, stated 36497.97/24043.47, county-form layout on both sides, and the audit's 1250.00-gap note.

contributions.detail: 149 rows sum to 36497.97 = Summary line 1 Column A. The schedule's printed grand total 35247.97 sits exactly 1250.00 BELOW line 1 because every page subtotal (and hence the grand total) EXCLUDES the one in-kind row the schedule nonetheless lists (p6 row 13, Ryan Sullivan 1250.00, marked 'In-Kind') - schedule-total-vs-summary-gap. Non-in-kind rows alone sum 35247.97 = the printed schedule grand total; both anchors close.

expenditures.detail: 21 rows sum to 24043.47 = Summary line 2 Column A = the schedule's printed grand total (16332.55 p13 + 7710.92 p14). Both anchors agree.
